Overview

Erfurt is a city in Thuringia with a population of 214,000. Thuringia’s capital, a medieval treasure with a stunning cathedral, the Krämerbrücke, Martin Luther’s legacy, and a vibrant cultural scene. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
